steps.name: clean: before the run: every rating on movieId and taggedId removed through the moderation API
steps.script: const removed = []; for (const item of [__vars.movieId, __vars.taggedId]) { const page = await __jfurDetails.server('GET', 'UserRatings/Admin/Reviews?itemId=' + item + '&limit=200'); if (page.status !== 200) { throw new Error('list ' + page.status); } for (const row of page.json.Items) { const path = 'UserRatings/Admin/Reviews/' + row.RatingId + '?textOnly=false'; const dry = await __jfurDetails.server('DELETE', path); const done = await __jfurDetails.server('DELETE', path + '&dryRun=false&ifPreview=' + dry.json.PreviewToken); removed.push(done.status); } } return removed;

steps.name: clean: the synthetic member deleted
steps.script: const users = (await ApiClient.getUsers()).filter(u => u.Name === "عضو تجريبي باسم طويل جدا للتحقق من العزل في قائمة الإشراف rtl9"); for (const u of users) { await ApiClient.deleteUser(u.Id); } return users.length;
